rules.why: The Icon Button is a native <button>, or <a href> when it navigates.
Inside a <form> the HTML default is submit: the type is always written.
An Icon Button that navigates is <a href>; without href it receives no Tab.
While loading, the button stays focusable but inert: aria-busy goes with aria-disabled.
The svg is paint; the button's name is what speaks.

manual.why: The name is on the button, in one way: a non-empty aria-label or an aria-labelledby to an element with text - never both, never neither.
